name: catalyst
_comment_title_suffix: The <title> element ends with the publisher's name on every page. Stripped so folder names and note titles match what the episode is called.
_comment_corrections: Published transcripts render the host's name phonetically. Each entry is applied to the whole document and tallied in the transcript's frontmatter, so every change is visible.

corrections.note: host name as published (Shayle Khan) corrected to Shayle Kann

_comment_non_speakers: Labels that match the speaker-label shape but are not people. 'tag' is the show's intro bumper and appeared in 48 episodes before it was caught.
_comment_boilerplate: Sponsor reads, credits and the footer bio. These are filtered BEFORE the transcript start is located, because a line like 'Credits:' otherwise matches the speaker-label regex and drags sponsor copy into the dialogue.
boilerplate: ^This episode of Catalyst is brought to you by
^Sh(?:ay|a)le\s+(?:Kann|Khan|Kahn|Cann)\s+is a partner at Energy Impact Partners
